research.title: Agent Observability: Silent Watchdogs, Infinite Retries and Phantom Events in Production
research.whyTrending: The failure modes of production agents are finally being written down - stranded tickets, retry storms, events that fire for work that never happened, watchdogs that die quietly. This is the operational layer nobody covers: what to trace, what to alert on, what a good agent SLO looks like. Pairs with OpenTelemetry tooling we've already covered.
